messages:
Ava (Support): quick thread — Novalyx (acct NX-089) reached out: their AP requires an official PO number and completed VAT form before we can issue an invoice. They're asking us not to bill until PO arrives. They want an option to pay sooner (proforma) so they don't lose budget window. Can finance advise?

Liam (Novalyx - Procurement): confirming. Our procurement policy mandates PO# on any supplier invoice + vendor tax/VAT certificate. Legal is still reviewing the SOW, so we can't issue the PO until approvals complete. Can Redwood issue a proforma or a draft invoice we can attach to our PO request?

Maya (Account Exec): looping @Jorge and @Priya — customer is on Dedicated Monthly ($12k/mo commit). We should avoid cutting access. They have used up current month credits, want continuity.

Jorge (Finance): short answer: we can produce a proforma invoice (non-recognized for revenue) to let the customer pay AP, but we can't book official revenue without a PO for B2B orders where PO is a contractual requirement. Options: 1) issue proforma and accept payment, mark account as "pending PO" for accounting; 2) allow a provisional 14-day extension of service while they obtain PO; 3) escalate for PO exception if customer needs invoice issued without PO (needs exec sign-off). Which does the customer prefer?

Liam (Novalyx - Procurement): proforma + provisional access would work best. We can route payment quickly if you provide supplier tax details + bank wiring instructions. Also need the invoice/draft to include: PO field (we'll populate later), our VAT ID, and the SOW reference.

Priya (Legal): for the record: if we accept payment against a proforma, add a statement: "Payment accepted subject to issuance of official invoice upon receipt of PO and completed procurement paperwork." That covers us. If we later issue the official invoice with PO#, we can add an amendment referencing the payment.

Ava (Support): copying a quick proforma template I'll use so finance can edit:```
Proforma:
  supplier: Redwood Inference, Inc.
  supplier_tax_id: [REDACTED]
  invoice_type: Proforma
  invoice_date: 2026-05-10
  amount_due: USD 12,000.00
  currency: USD
  invoice_to: Novalyx Ltd (VAT: [NOVALYX_VAT])
  PO_field: (to be filled by customer)
  notes: Payment accepted pending submission of official PO and signed SOW.
```

Jorge (Finance): @Liam can you confirm the bank wiring details and the exact VAT number we should show? I'll generate the proforma and send to payments@novalyx.com and cc @Maya. I'll also tag the account with an internal flag "awaiting_po" so billing doesn't auto-issue a final invoice.

Liam (Novalyx - Procurement): VAT is GB999888777. Bank details: they want beneficiary name + address on the proforma. Use full legal name + registered address. I'll confirm wire beneficiary by EOD.

Maya (Account Exec): I'll track this on the account and push legal for faster SOW sign-off. Also adding link to our billing doc for the customer: https://redwood.example.com/docs/billing/proforma-guidance — includes sample tax fields.

BillingBot: Automations note: invoice automation paused for acct NX-089 (hold reason: awaiting PO). Next automated invoice run skipped.

Jorge (Finance): actioning — I'll send the proforma now. If the customer pays, we can keep service live and update official invoice after PO arrives. If they can't pay, we'll grant a 14-day provisional access to avoid disruption.

Ava (Support): summary/action items: 1) @Jorge send proforma + supplier tax id (in flight). 2) @Liam confirm beneficiary info and VAT (customer). 3) @Maya follow up on SOW sign-off and escalate if >48h. 4) Support to monitor account flag and ensure no auto-invoices. Please update this thread when payment or PO received. :white_check_mark:

Liam (Novalyx - Procurement): thanks all — will update once AP has the proforma and beneficiary verified. Appreciate the provisional access option.

(End of thread)
